item.title: 'KPop Demon Hunters' makes history with 2 Oscar nominations, including Best Original Song
item.description: KPop Demon Hunters has officially entered awards-season heavyweight territory, earning two nominations at the 98th Academy Awards — a major win for K-pop-inspired storytelling on the world’s biggest film stage. item.title: Palm Tree Music Festival to make Singapore debut this April
item.description: Palm Tree Music Festival is officially heading to Singapore for the very first time, with its debut set for 18 April at The Meadows, Gardens by the Bay. Pre-sale registration is now open, with fans encouraged to join the waitlist ahead of the festival’s 2026 lineup announcement. item.title: The Line Divides revisit ‘90s Cebu in comeback single ‘Nobenta’ — listen

item.title: RIIZE’s Anton & Sohee join Minister Edwin Tong at SM Universe Singapore opening ceremony
item.description: SM Entertainment has officially opened SM Universe Singapore, marking the company’s first K-pop training academy outside South Korea and a major step in expanding its global talent development pipeline. item.title: Chinese rap sensation GAI is bringing his 'Evolution' world tour to Singapore this March
